title and abstract.summary: The study investigated the responses of ground beetle assemblages to stand characteristics and surrounding landscape structure in riparian poplar forests by measuring carabid activity density, species diversity, and functional diversity.

methods.summary: The study describes the location and sampling design of plots within natural poplar forests along the Irtysh River, but it does not detail any specific measurements taken on the listed plant species.

results.summary: The study measured the activity density and species diversity of ground beetles across different poplar forest stands, analyzing how landscape structure and stand characteristics influenced these metrics.
